title: Encyclopedia Galactica alien taxonomy sent to the congressman

tellings.quote: somebody sent me both volumes of the Encyclopedia Galactica

plain: A congressman named Eric Burlison says that someone sent him both volumes of a document called the Encyclopedia Galactica, which is described as a catalogue of alien types. He tells Michels this himself, without saying who sent it, and if the document is what it claims to be, it would be a guide to the kinds of beings said to visit Earth.
